'''Unit 8826''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] present on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] during the [[battle of Ukio]]. A battle droid once mistook the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sanya]] for 8826.
